messages:
Lina (Design): Dropping a quick thread for the trace UX review I demo'd this morning. Focus areas: compact stack presentation, shareable permalink for a trace snapshot, and export discoverability.

Omar (Eng): Saw the demo. Love the compact rows but worried about losing context for async stacks (promises/callbacks). How would we show async jumps?

Lina (Design): Plan is to show a subtle connector icon → between frames that are async boundaries, with a tooltip "async boundary: parent span X". Kept minimal so dense traces don't bloat.

Priya (Product): Async boundary tooltip sounds good. Can we also surface a quick action to "Expand async chain" so product teams can quickly see causality without hunting?

Tess (Accessibility): A few things: (1) connectors must have aria-hidden=true if they are purely decorative, (2) the tooltip must be accessible via keyboard focus on the frame row, and (3) ensure color isn't the sole clue for async vs synchronous. Consider a tiny label "async" in a neutral chip.

Omar (Eng): Will implement focusable rows and make the connector decorative. For the "async" chip, we can reuse existing chip component to avoid extra styles.

Raj (SRE): About permalink/share: we need two modes — transient (expires in 24h) for quick share, and persistent (project-scoped, audit-logged) for PMs/bug reports. Persistent links should require role=viewer+ permission.

Priya (Product): Yes — add an explicit dialog when creating a persistent link: checkbox "Include sensitive headers and env variables" with default OFF. Also log who created the link and include revoke button.

Lina (Design): UX for the share modal: left column preview (small stack + metadata), right column link settings (expiry, include headers toggle, make public toggle if allowed). Small copy: title = "Share trace snapshot"; primary CTA = "Create link".

Omar (Eng): Implementation note: snapshot creation will call POST /api/traces/{id}/snapshots with body {expiry, include_sensitive}. Snapshot returns signed URL. We'll need server-side sanitizers for include_sensitive=false.

Tess (Accessibility): Modal must trap focus, have aria-labelledby pointing to the title, and ensure the checkbox labels are clickable (for mac VoiceOver). Also keyboard-only users must be able to copy the link via keyboard (a copy button with aria-live toast).

Lina (Design): Export placement: currently an inline "Export" action and a kebab with "Export full JSON". I think we should: make inline action "Snapshot & Download" and keep CSV/JSON variants in kebab. That aligns with sharing model.

Priya (Product): Rename tooltip copy from "Export" to "Snapshot and download (includes attachments)" for clarity. Also add a short warning for enterprise tenants: "May include tokens or PII".

Raj (SRE): Agree on warning. For large traces, streaming download and gzipping server-side will help. Also set a size cap for snapshot downloads (configurable per-tenant).

Omar (Eng): We'll stream and compress. For clients that request CSV, we'll convert on-the-fly and stream rows. Edge case: when a trace has thousands of annotations, CSV generation is heavy; queue it and give user a notification when ready.

Tess (Accessibility): For the callstack folding option (collapse repeated frames), the toggle must be exposed in the toolbar with aria-pressed state. The collapsed row text should be descriptive: e.g., "Collapsed: 24 identical frames (expand)". Avoid ambiguous icons alone.

Lina (Design): Good. Visual density control: micro / default / compact — we should add a small dropdown in the trace header. Compact default for very long traces. Copy: label it "Density" not "View".

Priya (Product): Telemetry: track events for "create_snapshot", "download_snapshot", "toggle_density", and "expand_collapsed_frames". Will help quantify the most-used flows.

Raj (SRE): Also track snapshot sizes and generation time for autoscaling the snapshot workers.

Omar (Eng): Quick question about correlation IDs: current badge is tappable and invokes the global search. Do we want a long-press menu on mobile to "Search globally" vs "Search within project"?

Lina (Design): Yes — afford both. Default tap = search within current project. Long-press or kebab on badge = "Search across org" with permission guard. Mobile hint: small chevron on the badge.

Tess (Accessibility): Ensure long-press equivalents exist for keyboard users (e.g., context menu key or shift+F10 opens same menu).

Priya (Product): Copy tweak for correlation badge tooltip: "Correlation ID — click to find related traces (within this project)". If org-search requires extra permission, show tooltip "Cross-project search — request access" when disabled.

Lina (Design): Color considerations: add a color-blind-friendly palette for status badges (error/warn/success). We'll include a setting "Use high-contrast status colors" in user preferences.

Omar (Eng): We'll wire an experimental flag and CSS variables. Raj: any infra concerns?

Raj (SRE): None. Just remember to default to standard palette and let users opt-in. Also add rate limits on org-wide search to prevent abuse.

infra-bot: Background job snapshot-generator-382 queued (eta ~3m).

Lina (Design): Action items from this thread: (1) Omar: async connector + focusable rows + streaming snapshot endpoint; (2) Tess: a11y checklist for modal/tooltips/toolbar controls; (3) Priya: copy for warnings and telemetry spec; (4) Raj: snapshot caps and rate limit config. I'll update the Figma flows and attach link here.

Omar (Eng): Starting work on a PR for focus + collapse text today. Will post design-implementation diff.

Tess (Accessibility): Will review once PR is up.

Priya (Product): I'll draft the export/privacy help doc for enterprise.

Lina (Design): Thanks team. If anyone spots an accessibility or security miss in the mockups, ping here. :raised_hands:
